description: Cases of the process.lock form (docs/spec/endpoint.md#discovery) that a writing command of sok replays in Go and Rust. A content is written to process.lock, then the command `plugin enable probe` runs. $LIVE is the pid of the test process, which is running; $DEAD is a pid that is not running. The outcome `refused-live` names the owner, `refused-invalid` names the file and its content, and `taken` runs the command beyond the lock.
